verdict.rationale: Salv's API docs say the API definition can be downloaded as a YAML file (public.yaml) for import into Postman. Content quoted from that file, such as environment server selection and endpoint semantics, confirms it is a machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: the docs never explicitly name the spec format or version (e.g. OpenAPI 3.x), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: API definition to import into Postman can be downloaded at https://docs.salv.com/api/public.yaml
